summary: A Mobirise one-pager (captured from the Wayback Machine) for Octothorpe, a 1970s multi-line 'stripes' display revival: 24 full-screen panels, each a pre-rendered PNG/GIF of white striped lettering on a flat colour, with the background colour blending panel to panel through a rainbow (red → magenta → violet → blue → cyan → green → yellow → red). Captioned feature panels ('8 great reasons to love Octothorpe') alternate with pangrams in several languages and display phrases; no live text in the font.

instances.look: Flat red screen with a small black 'pampatype' wordmark above 'OCTOTHORPE®' in white six-line striped capitals (~130px tall, ~1020px wide); the stripes of the last 'P' run straight down off the bottom of the screen; round translucent ↓ button at the bottom centre
instances.ux: Static image panel with a jarallax parallax background; the ↓ button jumps to the next panel
instances.learn: Let one letter's stripes keep running off the panel: the multi-line construction becomes a graphic device that leads the eye into the scroll

reconstruction.layout: Full-screen section (100vh) under a 64px fixed black nav; wordmark centred at ~45% height, foundry logo ~60px above it; stripe tail from the 'P' (x≈930) to the bottom edge; ↓ button 56px circle centred ~60px from the bottom
reconstruction.typography: Name in Octothorpe caps (pre-rendered image), each stroke 6 parallel white lines, ~130px cap height; foundry logo ~26px bold lowercase black; UI in Chercan ~16px
reconstruction.behaviour: Background image in a jarallax container (parallax on scroll); arrow is an anchor to #next
reconstruction.content: Name only, with ® and foundry logo
reconstruction.assets: Pre-rendered PNG of the wordmark (octothorpe.png) at 1920px wide

instances.look: Full-screen poster panels of white striped lettering on colour fields that blend into each other: the English pangram in four stacked lines on red, lowercase 'octothorpe' with stripes running up and down, '—QUESTION EVERYTHING —WHY?' on violet, formulas '(x+y)²=4×(½)xy+z²', 'PLATFORM 9¾', 'C₁₀H₁₂N₂O' on cyan, a two-slide carousel of a physics sentence ('For a finite-size system to evolve in such a way that… imposed currents') on green, prices '€ 9.823', '¥ 1.000,8000', '₿ 0,0007' on yellow
instances.ux: Scroll from panel to panel (each 100vh with a ↓ button); the green panel is a Bootstrap carousel with ← → buttons and no autoplay
instances.learn: Grade the background from one panel's colour into the next: a run of separate posters reads as one continuous rainbow scroll

reconstruction.layout: Sections of exactly 100vh; one centred composition per panel, 2–4 lines of display type ~900–1200px wide, ~100–140px cap height; backgrounds use vertical linear gradients at the panel edges so neighbouring colours meet seamlessly
reconstruction.typography: Octothorpe (image), 6-line striped strokes, caps or lowercase, line-height ~1.0, lines interlocking via connectors; tiny captions in Chercan ~14px white
reconstruction.behaviour: Static images (some animated GIFs); carousel slides change on button click (data-interval=false); ↓ anchors step to the next section
reconstruction.content: English pangram, slogan 'Question everything — why?', maths and chemistry formulas, a physics quote, currency amounts
reconstruction.assets: One pre-rendered PNG/GIF per panel (e.g. octothorpelc.png, finite01.png, externsors.png)
reconstruction.html: section.mbr-fullscreen with CSS background-image per section; carousel: section.carousel > .mbr-slider > .carousel-inner > .carousel-item.slider-fullscreen-image (img) + a.carousel-control-prev/next

instances.look: '8 GREAT REASONS TO LOVE OCTOTHORPE' as a striped title panel, then eight full-screen panels each with one small white caption: 'Contextual alternates' (a huge overlapping 'UG'), 'Swashes' (four rows of swash letters), 'Extensive diacritic coverage' (rows of accented A and other letters), 'Positional forms and fractions' (A¹²³ A₄₅₆ ⁷⁸/₉₀ and fractions), 'Extenders and connectors' ('EQUITY', 'pedigüeñería', 'MANNEQUIN' with long joining strokes), 'Cyrillic range', 'Extended currency', then '#8' and striped arrows and a pointing hand
instances.ux: Watch-and-scroll; the last dingbat panel is an animated GIF (the arrow changes direction)
instances.learn: Number the selling points ('8 great reasons') and give each feature one full screen with a one-line caption: a feature list becomes a paced show

reconstruction.layout: Each reason is a 100vh panel: centred specimen ~700–1200px wide, caption ~14px centred just below or between the lines; the reasons are interleaved with pangram panels
reconstruction.typography: Specimens in Octothorpe striped caps, lowercase, swashes, superior/inferior figures, Cyrillic, currency and arrow dingbats (images); captions Chercan ~14px white
reconstruction.behaviour: Static; the '#8' panel grades yellow → red and the dingbat panel loops an animation
reconstruction.content: Feature names as captions; sample letters and words chosen to show each feature (EQUITY, pedigüeñería, MANNEQUIN)

instances.look: Three pangram panels in white striped lettering, each with its English translation in brackets below: Italian 'Ma la volpe col suo balzo ha raggiunto il quieto Fido' on magenta, Polish 'Pchnąć w tę łódź jeża lub ośm skrzyń fig' on blue, Russian 'В чащах юга жил бы цитрус? Да, но фальшивый экземпляр!' on green
instances.learn: Translate each foreign pangram in a bracketed caption: visitors enjoy the sentence and still see which accents it exercises

reconstruction.layout: 100vh panels, 3–4 centred lines ~1000–1200px wide, ~70px cap height, caption ~14px below
reconstruction.typography: Octothorpe lowercase or caps (image) with diacritics and Cyrillic; captions Chercan ~14px white in parentheses
reconstruction.content: Classic pangrams in Italian, Polish and Russian with English translations ('(But the fox with his leap has reached quiet Fido)')

instances.look: Back on red: 'A REVIVAL OF ANTHONY WENMAN'S "STRIPES"' and 'ARCHETYPAL "STRIPES" FONT FROM THE 70'S' set as huge striped capitals; in the second the horizontal stripes run out to both screen edges
instances.learn: Tell the origin in two display sentences set in the revival itself: the backstory doubles as the last specimen

reconstruction.layout: Two 100vh panels; 4 centred lines each ~600–1000px wide, ~100px cap height; panel 2 extends the line stripes horizontally across the full width
reconstruction.content: Origin statement: revival of Anthony Wenman's 'Stripes' (1970s)
